llm_response.reason: This website shows a clear specialization in bird-related products, provides standard contact and business information (including a physical address and phone number in France), and contains many up-to-date and diverse customer reviews spanning multiple years. There are no signs of unusually low prices, impossible claims, urgency manipulation, ambiguous payment or contact info, or spoofing of brands. The operational history since 2006 further supports legitimacy, as scam websites typically use newer domains and conceal identity for short-term fraud. Therefore, no scam characteristics have been observed.
